notes: Houses in 3D, filled neighbourhoods, smaller vehicles

Homes near the camera in the 3D view now use a detailed Iraqi house model, in four variants (single storey, two storey with a set-back upper floor, rooftop water tanks, and a narrower house with a side annex), each in mixed colours and orientations. They swap in as you move around

Neighbourhoods that OpenStreetMap leaves unmapped are filled with houses lining the real streets, so cities no longer have large empty patches. Mapped buildings are drawn slightly smaller so dense quarters show their alleys
Vehicles and troops in 3D are half their old size so convoys fit on the streets
